name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1929: The inventory lattice and occupancy readers shipped with thirteen tests and zero callers - the same defect class as everything else this arc, a mechanism that reads as protection and carries nothing. Joined to the vault corpus scan, which already walks the archive: it now reports free inventory space per reel, sampling eight panel frames each and printing how many AGREED, because 93 of 94 is evidence and 1 of 1 is a fixture. Measured on his own archive it finds 18 free of 40 on two reels with unanimous agreement, and one reel at 1 free of 40 - a nearly full inventory, which is exactly what a vault manager exists to act on. Ten of sixteen reels hold no readable panel and say so rather than printing zero free. Wiring it up exposed a second defect: the block had been appended BELOW the main guard, so main ran before its constants existed and a 145 second scan died with NameError on its last line after every frame had been read. The same shape had already bitten a test file this session, where a guard existed; nothing covered the runnable modules, and the scope guard passed because it asks whether a name exists rather than whether it exists yet.
